arquebusiers.title: Arquebusiers
arquebusiers.caption: Arquebusiers
arquebusiers.searchHint: By name, DNI/NIE or Federation ID.

empty.title: No arquebusiers yet
empty.description: Register the first one with “Register arquebusier”.

arquebusiers.noMatches: No arquebusier matches the search or the filters.

unassigned.title: You have no comparsa assigned yet
unassigned.description: A Federation admin has to assign you to your comparsa before you can see its arquebusiers.

form.newDescription: The details of a comparsa member who takes part in the firing acts.
form.personalDescription: The DNI/NIE and the Federation ID cannot be repeated anywhere in the Federation.
form.federationIdHint: The arquebusier's code in the Federation's app.
form.nationalIdHint: DNI: 8 digits and the letter (add leading zeros if needed). NIE: X, Y or Z, 7 digits and the letter.
form.statusHint: In reserve they do not fire this year but stay on the list.
form.licenseDescription: Only the current license: renewing it replaces its details.
form.pendingHint: Applied for but not issued yet: it has no dates.
form.expiresOnHint: Worked out when the issue date or the type changes: 5 years for AE and 1 year for A-PROF. Once you change it yourself, it is no longer recalculated.
form.trainingDescription: Only whether the course is done, and when, is recorded.
form.trainingCompletedOnHint: Leave it empty if they have not done the course yet.
form.modified: Someone else changed this arquebusier while you were editing it. Their current details have been loaded: check your changes and save again.

detail.inactiveComparsa: The comparsa {{name}} is inactive: it takes no new arquebusiers, but you can still edit this one.

ownedWeapons.title: Owned weapons
ownedWeapons.description: The weapons they own, with their ownership guide.
ownedWeapons.caption: Owned weapons
ownedWeapons.removeDescription: It is deleted from the arquebusier's record and this cannot be undone.

form.description: The guide number cannot be repeated anywhere in the Federation.
form.weaponNumberHint: The number engraved on the stock.

transfer.title: Transfer to another comparsa
transfer.description: They move to the target comparsa with their owned weapons. Anything already recorded for past editions keeps its comparsa.
transfer.noTargets: There is no other active comparsa to transfer them to.
transfer.confirmDescription: They will move from {{from}} to {{to}} with their owned weapons. The firing chiefs of {{from}} will no longer see them.

delete.title: Delete from the registry
delete.description: Only when they leave the Federation.
delete.confirmDescription: This cannot be undone: their details and owned weapons are erased.
delete.reserveHint: If they only stop firing, set their record to Reserve instead: their details are kept. If they come back after the record is deleted, it has to be registered again from scratch.
delete.deleted: {{name}} has been deleted from the registry.

arquebusiers.notFound: This arquebusier does not exist or you cannot see them.

arquebusiers.federationIdTaken: That Federation ID is already registered in the Federation. If it is the same person, contact the Federation.
arquebusiers.federationIdTakenAdmin: That Federation ID is already registered in the Federation. Search for it in the registry.
arquebusiers.modified: Someone else changed this arquebusier while you were editing it.

ownedWeapons.modelInactive: That model is retired from the catalogue: choose another one.
ownedWeapons.guideTaken: That guide number is already registered in the Federation.
ownedWeapons.modified: Someone else changed this weapon while you were editing it.

registry.busy: The registry is busy with another change. Try again in a few seconds.

errors.tooManyRequests: You have made many changes in a row. Wait a minute and try again.

validation.checkLetter: The letter does not match the digits.
